projectDescription: An open-source, fully customizable multi-agent AI system that coordinates specialized agents (research, slides, docs, images, video, music production, and more) from a single terminal prompt.
keyFeatures: 10 specialized AI agents coordinated by a central orchestrator
One-command npm install with interactive setup wizard
Slides, documents, images, and video generation from a single prompt
House music production tools: Reference Finder, Ableton Dream Agent, and taste-aware curation engine
10,000+ external integrations via Composio (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Spotify, and more)
FastAPI server mode for API-driven deployments
Fully forkable — customize every agent's instructions and tools
Automated website publish pipeline via GitHub Actions
Multi-provider support: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini
publicApiSurface: Orchestrator agent: routing via SendMessage and Handoff
Virtual Assistant agent: file/email/calendar/Slack tools + Composio
Deep Research agent: evidence-based web research with citations
Data Analyst agent: IPython kernel, charts, statistical analysis
Slides Agent: HTML → PPTX export pipeline
Docs Agent: Word documents and PDF creation/conversion
Image Generation Agent: Gemini / fal.ai generate + edit + combine
Video Generation Agent: Sora / Veo / Seedance generation + editing
Reference Finder agent: audio capture → feature extraction → SearchReferences
Ableton Dream Agent: DreamSongSketch / SaveFeedback / ListSketches tools
Music Curation engine: scoring.py, discovery.py, publish.py pipeline
DEFAULT_MODEL env var (overrides model for all agents)
shared_tools/: ManageConnections, SearchTools, FindTools, ExecuteTool, CopyFile
